title: pepper-agent edit project, version 1
description: A cut: clips of files, one after another. `pepper-agent edit validate` checks it and lists every problem; `edit preview` shows it; `edit render` makes it. Anything not here is a problem, so a typo never goes unseen. edit validate, preview and timeline also read video-use's edl.json (github.com/browser-use/video-use) as it is: its ranges are the clips.

output.description: The render's frame. Left out, or any member left out: the first clip's size (made even), its frame rate, and pad.

fps.description: Frames a second, 1 to 240: 30, 29.97 or "30000/1001" (NTSC's decimal rates are taken as their exact fractions).

fit.description: A clip of another shape: pad shows all of it with black bars; crop fills the frame and cuts its edges.

time.description: A time in the file: seconds (83.5) or as written ("1:23.5", "00:01:23.500").

src.description: The file it's cut from: a path from the project file's folder, or absolute. It must have a picture. It's only read, never changed.

in.description: Where it starts in the file. Left out: 0.

out.description: Where it ends in the file. Left out: the file's end. After in by a frame of the output at least, and not past the file's end.

name.description: For people; marks on the preview give it as clip_name.

audio.description: The clip's sound. fade_in and fade_out together fit in the clip. A file without sound plays silence.

fade_in.description: Seconds from silence at its start.

fade_out.description: Seconds to silence at its end.
